entries.title: PostReady: PR #825 — GBP API access application package (#585)
entries.description: Added documentation package for applying for Google Business Profile API access, enabling PostReady to support GBP posting as a platform in future.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #824 — I5: Carousel editor accessibility (keyboard reorder, focus, SR labels)
entries.description: Carousel editor now supports keyboard-driven slide reordering, proper focus management, and screen-reader labels — meeting baseline accessibility standards.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #823 — Per-card AI image generate/regenerate for carousels (E2, #688)
entries.description: Each carousel card now supports individual AI image generation and regeneration, letting users refine specific slides without regenerating the full carousel.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #822 — Carousel export format presets — square/portrait/landscape (D9, #686)
entries.description: Carousel Creator now offers one-tap export format presets (square 1:1, portrait 4:5, landscape 16:9) so users can match the right aspect ratio for each platform.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #821 — D7: Image fit controls for carousel cards — no stretch (#684)
entries.description: Carousel cards now have image fit controls (cover/contain/fill) so uploaded photos never stretch or distort — each card maintains correct composition.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #820 — Multi-file batch upload → ordered carousel cards (#683)
entries.description: Users can now batch-upload multiple image files and they automatically become ordered carousel slides, dramatically speeding up photo-carousel creation.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #819 — Wire carousel props into pack publish surface (#695/#696)
entries.description: Carousel data (slide count, captions, images) now flows fully into the Post Packs publish surface, completing the end-to-end carousel → publish pipeline.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #817 — Manual download-all-cards + copy-caption fallback for carousels (#696)
entries.description: Added a download-all-cards action for carousels and a copy-caption fallback so users can always get their carousel content even when direct publishing is pending platform API approval.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #816 — Onboarding pivot: business category drives content suggestions (#707)
entries.description: Onboarding now uses the selected business category to drive post and content suggestions, giving new users more relevant starting ideas immediately after sign-up.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #818 — D5: "Add Photo" (editable canvas) vs "Upload Finished Card" (as-is) (#682)
entries.description: Added two distinct card-addition flows in Carousel Creator: "Add Photo" opens the editable canvas for styled slides; "Upload Finished Card" accepts finished artwork as-is for direct use.
